title: On Sliding into the ditch on the ice
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：slide　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 slide 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the tailor ① slid into the ditch on the ice in public, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② slides into the ditch on the ice in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ slide into the ditch on the ice at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ slid into the ditch on the ice before — a line in the order for November 1977 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sliding into the ditch on the ice in public, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ slide the note under the door in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Slide the note under the door at once and never mention it again.

By 1990 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ slides the note under the door in public every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ slid into the ditch on the ice again when nobody else would.

⑩ To slide into the ditch on the ice, my mother said in 1995, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody slides into the ditch on the ice in silence again and somebody must slide into the ditch on the ice in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 滑落（一般过去式 slid into the ditch on the ice：1983 年裁缝头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 滑落（一般现在 slides into the ditch on the ice：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 滑落（不定式 to slide into the ditch on the ice：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 滑落（过去完成时 had slid into the ditch on the ice：1977 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 滑落（动名词 sliding into the ditch on the ice 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 塞进（slide the note under the door：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去塞进把字条从门下塞进去）
G. v. 塞进（slide the note under the door：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 滑落（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 slides the note under the door，而母亲又一次 slid into the ditch on the ice）

answers.why: slide 意为“滑落”，1983 年裁缝当着众人面滑落在冰上滑进了那条沟，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 slid。
slide 意为“滑落”，自那以后裁缝一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 slides。
slide 意为“滑落”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯滑落在冰上滑进了那条沟”，此处为不定式 to slide into the ditch on the ice。
slide 意为“滑落”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1990 年之前就有人滑落过，故用过去完成时 had slid。
slide 意为“滑落”，裁缝说“滑落在冰上滑进了那条沟这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 sliding into the ditch on the ice 作主语。
slide 意为“塞进”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去塞进把字条从门下塞进去”，should ever 之后用原形 slide the note under the door。
slide 意为“塞进”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻塞进把字条从门下塞进去（slide the note under the door at once），以后再也不要提起。
slide 意为“滑落”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例塞进把字条从门下塞进去，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 slides。
slide 意为“滑落”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面滑落在冰上滑进了那条沟，用一般过去式 slid 叙述。
slide 意为“滑落”，结尾那句是母亲 1995 年的话：要滑落在冰上滑进了那条沟，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 slide 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the tailor slid into the ditch on the ice in public, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor slides into the ditch on the ice in silence whenever the shop asks.
Sliding into the ditch on the ice in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever slide the note under the door in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop slides the note under the door in public every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother slid into the ditch on the ice again, and the shop remembered that half.
